tpms.when: 2019–2022 Prius, set from the Maintenance System menu in the multi-information display
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park and turn the vehicle on.
Use the steering wheel switches that run the multi-information display to reach the Maintenance System menu and open it.
Select TPMS, then press and hold the select switch until a message shows on the display and the tire pressure light comes on.
Release the switch. The system now uses the pressures you just set.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2019, 2020 and 2022 Prius Quick Reference Guides.
